name: Elder Bloodhoof
summary: During the Lunar Festival, Elder Bloodhoof rests just north of Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore. The Bloodhoof tribe honors him as a guardian spirit of its ancestors.

sections.title: Spirit of the Ancestors
sections.body: Near Bloodhoof Village, Elder Bloodhoof watches over his people. The tauren honor him as a spirit bound to their lineage and to the plains of Mulgore. During the Lunar Festival, respectful travelers seek his wisdom and receive his blessings. His presence keeps the guidance of dead chieftains and tribal forebears close to the Bloodhoof tribe.

aliases: who is the ghost outside bloodhoof village
faq.answer: Elder Bloodhoof is a ghostly tauren spirit who rests just north of Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore. The Bloodhoof tribe honors him as one of its ancestors and seeks his wisdom during the Lunar Festival.

faq.q: When can you see Elder Bloodhoof?
faq.answer: You can see Elder Bloodhoof during the annual Lunar Festival, when he appears to offer blessings.

faq.q: What is his connection to Bloodhoof Village?
aliases: why is he near bloodhoof village
faq.answer: Elder Bloodhoof rests just north of Bloodhoof Village and watches over the Bloodhoof tribe. Tauren tradition holds ancestral spirits close to the places where their descendants live and gather.

angles.text: As a tauren, you can honor your tribal lineage by paying respects to Elder Bloodhoof, an ancestor revered by the Bloodhoof tribe.
As a shaman, you can look to Elder Bloodhoof as an ancestral spirit who guides and protects his descendants.
